data.title: 一色彩羽 · 雨天收好的活动横幅
data.description: 活动被雨打断，彩羽穿米白防雨外套和灰色工装长裤，坐在器材室矮凳上把湿横幅卷齐。她先皱眉捋顺一处褶皱，听见窗外雷声又稍稍一顿，最后故作镇定地抱好卷成筒的布。
data.action: 捋平湿横幅卷成筒，听见雷声后故作镇定地抱好。
data.promptProse: Iroha smooths the damp event banner across her knees and rolls it evenly, pausing at a thunder rumble before holding the finished bundle with deliberate composure. Cream waterproof jacket, red shirt and charcoal cargo trousers retain the working outfit. The medium view includes stacked equipment and rain at the high window. Broad soft overhead light illuminates her face and banner folds, casting contained stool and equipment shadows rather than hiding her expression.
